DIAGNOSIS READY: Porphyria Cutanea Tarda (PCT)

The combination of a chronic pruritic rash on sun-exposed areas (face/upper body), sensory disturbances in the palms, and exposure to agricultural toxins strongly suggests PCT. The "spooning" of fingertips is a classic sign of secondary amyloidosis, which is a known complication of long-standing PCT. Given the occupational risk factors (rice farming/livestock), please confirm if you have a history of liver disease or alcohol consumption, and ensure the CBC and Liver_Function_Tests ordered previously are reviewed immediately.
